channel.title: Love Rat
channel.desc: The story of three women who joined forces to foil a serial love cheat and fraudster, featuring extraordinary footage of their sting. Forty-four-year-old Simon Reid had already left a trail of broken hearts across the US and UK when he met Laura Buckingham, Nicola Hillary and Jo Ward. All three were seduced by the same `Mr Right' and planned to settle down with him. They had no idea they were sharing the same man.[(96057)]
